standard_prerequisites.reference: The ADM mass and the Gauss-Bonnet-Chern mass of an asymptotically flat end, the decay conditions on the metric, and the divergence identities relating the mass integrand to the curvature of the level sets.
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies background that the delivered proof uses. The entry is declared as a dependency; it is not re-proved on the card, and the load-bearing steps of the counted statement are carried out inside the delivered span.

core_obligations: Prove the extrinsic formula for the mass of an asymptotically flat manifold, identifying the mass integrand with the integral over the large sphere of the extrinsic curvature data.
proof_roadmap: Step 1: write the mass as a flux integral over the boundary spheres at infinity. Step 2: use the divergence identities to rewrite the boundary integrand through the second fundamental form of the level sets and the ambient curvature. Step 3: pass to the limit along the expanding spheres to obtain the stated extrinsic expression.
